newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Caisses d'Epargne moves to co-op status.
newsitem.headline: French Caisses d'Epargne moves to co-op status.

text.p: French savings bank grouping Caisses d'Epargne said on Thursday its central board had approved the principle of changing its legal status to that of a co-operative and that the change would make alliances and external growth easier.

Rene Barbeyre, chief executive of the central board, told a news briefing the main lines of the proposal would be put to the various savings banks in the grouping in the coming weeks and talks would also be conducted with the public authorities.
The change in statutes requires legislative support.
